headlines.title: Hefty extra budgets leave Japan's industry ministry bloated
Japan logs 1.1 trillion yen trade deficit in August
Japan's Nikkei flat as investors await Fed, BOJ decisions
Asian stocks steady as traders await Fed decision
Japan August imports jump as oil prices lift costs, exports stay firm
Bessent defends Trump economic policies, plans to meet Chinese official
USD/JPY outlook: Central bank guidance key with a dash of Japanese fiscal pressure

marketTone.ko: 오늘 일본 증시는 투자자들이 미국 연방준비제도(Fed)와 일본은행(BOJ)의 통화정책 결정을 기다리며 대체로 보합세를 보였습니다. 주요 테마로는 유가 상승에 따른 수입 비용 증가로 1.1조 엔의 8월 무역 적자가 기록되었으나, 수출은 견조했습니다. 시장은 중앙은행의 향후 가이던스에 주목하고 있으며, 일본의 재정 압력 또한 주시해야 할 요인으로 언급되었습니다.
marketTone.en: Japanese stocks remained largely flat today as investors adopted a cautious stance, awaiting key monetary policy decisions from both the U.S. Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan. A significant theme was Japan's August trade deficit of 1.1 trillion yen, driven by surging import costs due to higher oil prices, though exports remained firm. The market is closely watching central bank guidance, with a notable mention of Japanese fiscal pressure as a potential factor.
